## Dictate Live
- **Text arrives sooner:** live text now comes in pieces every 5 to 12 seconds instead of in long lumps of up to 50 seconds.
- A spoken "Punkt" that was glued onto the word before it ("Rollatorpunkt") now becomes a period. Real compounds such as "Zeitpunkt" stay whole.
- "Neue Absatz" now starts a new paragraph, like "neuer Absatz".
- GdB is written consistently: "Einzel-GdB 30", "Gesamt-GdB", "GdB 10".
- "ich" after a comma at the start of a new piece is no longer capitalised.

## Dictate Prompt
- The quick actions on the ⌘2 card (⌃1 to ⌃3) keep their position instead of reshuffling after every run.

## Feedback
- Send Feedback ▸ **Report a Problem with Last Result…** now also covers the last Dictate Prompt answer and the last Read Aloud, not only the last dictation. **Report Something Else** switches between them.

## Other
- The MCP server falls back to a free port when 47823 is already taken, for example by WhisperShortcut running in a second macOS user.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.93...v8.94
